description.value:
Choosing this pursuit unlocks discoveries drawn from your study of maps and hidden routes. Each time you gain a new discovery, you may take one of the following instead, listed alphabetically.

Cover Adept (12th level required). You treat quarter cover as half cover, half cover as three-quarter cover, and three-quarter cover as full cover. While benefiting from any cover, your Dexterity (Stealth) checks also gain a bonus equal to your Critical Analysis ability modifier (minimum +1).

Dungeon Explorer. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to find secret doors or traps, and you have resistance to trap damage. Following the rules of your Sage Advice feature, you can also teach that same trap resistance to friendly creatures you choose.

Galactic Explorer (9th level required). On an Intelligence (Piloting) check to which your proficiency bonus applies, treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

Grappling Hunter (5th level required). You attack with advantage against any creature you're grappling.

High Ground (5th level required). Once per turn, when you or a friendly creature hits your Critical Analysis target, it takes extra damage equal to half your Critical Analysis ability modifier (minimum +1).

No Stone Left Unturned. Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) checks to spot a hidden creature within your Critical Analysis area are made with advantage.

Versatile Explorer. You can hold your breath twice as long as normal, and you take only half damage from falling.
